analysis:
This PR changes only documentation: a new changelog.d/overlapped-weight-verification.md, and a paragraph in docs/reference/configuration.md (head lines 602-606). Both describe an overlapped weight-hash read. A reader thread runs one 4 MiB chunk ahead of SHA-256 and uses two page-aligned buffers per file (OverlappedFileDigest). The F_NOCACHE read, the PageCache.drop step and the digests are stated to be unchanged.

No source code is in the supplied batch, so the implementation of OverlappedFileDigest and WeightHasher.uncachedChunkBytes was not reviewed. The docs describe no new endpoint, trust boundary, key handling, authorization or data exposure change. The changelog and configuration text claim the digests are unchanged, and those claims match the base documentation. The affected paths are startup registration, download and prefetch verification, and the pre/post-load hashes for SSD prefix caching. These relate to A-004, T-012, T-027 and T-041, but the doc change alters no threat-model control.

Open questions for the code pass, if the implementation is in another batch: whether a read error or short read on the reader thread fails closed, whether a mid-hash file mutation is detected (a TOCTOU window), whether the thread handoff can deadlock or leak, and whether the hash still binds to the verified-weights record's inode/size/time stamps. Nothing in the supplied evidence shows a regression. The doc-only change is low risk, but implementation correctness is unverified.
